findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - The proof line claims this test verifies that a post-merge `check:` entry is accepted. The fixture starts SHOP/T1, which covers only item 1 (`tests/test_close.py:53`), but the `check:` entry is for item 2. `proof.py:200-204` checks only covered items, so neither close nor the later PR check tests this entry. The assertions would still pass if a covered `check:` entry were rejected as having no test.
findings.title: Test: 1: tests/test_review_pending_after_merge.py::test_1_pending_after_merge_does_not_block_and_lists_check_and_owner

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - The proof line says accepting the blocker leaves the pending check undismissed, but this assertion checks only for `dismissed because` before the fold. `pr_block.py:34-36` omits pending findings from the dismissal detail regardless of whether they were dismissed, and `pr_block.py:60` lists them regardless. If accept also dismissed the pending check, these assertions would still pass; the test does not check the published dismissal count.
